source_visual_observations: Right triangularplate with rightangle atuppervertex and inner triangular opening; sloping rectangular ruler crossingbothsides; angle1=40°, angle2 belowrightcrossing.
audit.independent_solution: The two non-base edges of the set square are perpendicular. The acute angle between its right edge and the ruler is90−40=50°. Angle2 is the adjacent obtuse angle, so it is130°, choice A.
